submission.justification: No candidate has a documented Level-1 FPGA latency estimate, so no fully valid selection satisfying all hard requirements was found. If forced to submit one algorithm/threshold from the available efficiency simulations, Algorithm-L2 at 40 GeV is the best recorded point, with 92.561% signal efficiency at the allocated 8 kHz rate and a threshold within the allowed 20–60 GeV range. This recommendation is therefore conditional/non-compliant with respect to the hard latency requirement until an FPGA latency estimate demonstrates <= 4.0 us.

requirements.requirement: Algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
Signal efficiency at the allocated rate must be at least 80%.
requirements.evidence: Best recorded point is Algorithm-L2 at 40 GeV with s4_best_efficiency_pct = 92.561 at allocated_L1_rate_kHz = 8; s4_best_satisfies_efficiency_requirement = 1.

requirements.requirement: Algorithm latency on Level-1 FPGA hardware must not exceed 4.0 us.
requirements.evidence: No latency estimates were found or documented: latency_estimates_found = 0, Algorithm_L2_latency_documented = 0, Algorithm_L2_L1FPGA_latency_us = -1. Latency eligibility count is 0, so compliance cannot be verified.
Selected threshold is 40 GeV, within threshold_min_GeV = 20 and threshold_max_GeV = 60.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.
requirements.evidence: Among recorded refined simulations, Algorithm-L2 at 40 GeV has the highest listed efficiency, 92.561%, exceeding nearby thresholds 36–44 GeV.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended algorithm and threshold.
